title: PX Semantic Relation Record
description: A typed graph edge between two canonical entity_ids. A relation is a separate record from its endpoints, so neither entity needs to know it exists. Both endpoints must resolve to live entities: a relation whose endpoint is missing or retired is dangling and is rejected rather than persisted.

relation_id.description: Derived from source, kind and target, so re-asserting the same edge is idempotent.

target_entity_id.description: Null only for a relation that targets a resource outside the entity graph. Such a relation may never be used as a graph edge for traversal or closure.

external_target.description: Required when target_entity_id is null so the edge remains inspectable.
